notes: New Sample Dispatch: 'Fill from a file' — paste a picture (Ctrl+V), drop or choose a picture or PDF (visiting card, letterhead, GST certificate, e-mail screenshot). A GSTIN is looked up on the GST portal as before; otherwise company, name, mobiles, e-mail, address, pincode, city, state and Digipin are read from the file. Pictures and scanned PDFs are read with the text recognition built into Windows on the main PC.
